changes.evidence: Doom is the monarch of Latveria (a nation group the app already uses). In Spider-Man (1994) episode 63 (Secret Wars Chapter 3: Doom) he rules the Battleworld domain he names 'New Latveria'; in X-Men '97 episode 8 he speaks for Latveria at Operation: Zero Tolerance and is credited as 'Latverian OZT Member'. Latveria membership is never recorded.

Malick founded and runs Gothite Industries (his company; employer counts). Named on screen in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3 episode 11 'Bouncing Back': a news report says 'Gothite Industry closed ten offices today... Gideon Malick could not be reached for comment' after Coulson threatens him. Not recorded. Placed before HYDRA so the S3 HYDRA stage and the S3 departure (he betrays HYDRA to Coulson in episode 61 before Daisy kills him, so left S3 and Independent pass) stay as they are.

Nothing has him act alone, so Independent looks wrong; but whether Diamondback's men are still the Stokes Crime Family (Diamondback's own record keeps The Stokes Crime Family to the end) or an unnamed 'Diamondback's crew' is a naming call (crew names are held).
options: Drop the Independent stage and the Luke Cage S1 left title: Zip stays in The Stokes Crime Family under Diamondback, as Diamondback's record does
Replace Independent with a Diamondback's-crew stage at Luke Cage S1 (name to be decided; the screen does not clearly name it)
